namespace.description: The namespace this chart CREATES and installs its page objects into. It is the RBAC boundary the chart exists for — a group with no RoleBinding here cannot `list` the page roots, so the portal sidebar never shows them and the page body 403s on a deep link. The release itself stays wherever the composition is created; only the page objects live here.
namespace.title: namespace

dataNamespace.description: Namespace holding the KubernetesTarget CRs and the derived spoke endpoint Secrets — the DATA, not the pages. The registration flow writes them in the portal's release namespace and this chart does not move them.
dataNamespace.title: dataNamespace

readerGroups.description: Groups granted read of these pages in `namespace`. A group listed here sees /clusters in the sidebar and can open it; a group absent cannot list the page roots, so the entry never renders. `devs` is deliberately NOT a default — keeping it out is the point of the split (#261).
readerGroups.title: readerGroups

spokeReadbackEndpointNamespace.description: Namespace of the derived spoke endpoint Secret, which must be readable by snowplow's ServiceAccount. Mirrors the portal chart's value of the same name; these pages were split out of it and read the same Secret.
spokeReadbackEndpointNamespace.title: spokeReadbackEndpointNamespace
